record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the training objective with incumbent pointwise logistic loss plus 0.25 times the masked mean of softplus(negative_score-positive_score), using exactly the existing sampled pairs. The pairwise term directly encourages candidate separation while the retained pointwise term anchors score magnitudes. Preserve sampling, scoring, readout, features, embeddings, causal backbone, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. Train and load exactly one model per category.

--- 
+++ 
@@ -156,5 +156,7 @@
     pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
     mask = (pos != 0).float()
-    loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+    pointwise_loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+    pairwise_loss = nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
+    loss = pointwise_loss + 0.25 * pairwise_loss
     return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

category_rationales.rationale: Retain pointwise logistic supervision and add a 0.25-weighted pairwise ranking term over the same sampled pairs and nonpadding positions across all four datasets. This may improve candidate separation while preserving score calibration, sampling, architecture and inference.
